verdict.rationale: No evidence shows a dedicated bulk or batch operation primitive. The support is indirect: observe() returns multiple structured actions you can execute, extract() returns typed structured data from a page, and v4 has no autonomous loop, so the developer writes the orchestration and can iterate over items in code. The v3 agent can also run multi-step autonomous workflows. Missing for 10: a documented batch or bulk-action API, examples of acting on many items at once (e.g., multi-row or multi-page operations), concurrency or parallel-session guidance, and independent corroboration of bulk use.
